map.输入磨损率、允许磨损量与运行时间，计算磨损寿命与建议检测周期: Enter wear rate, allowable wear and operating time to compute wear life and recommended inspection interval
map.剩余寿命 ≈ (允许磨损量 ÷ 磨损率 ÷ 日运行时间) − 已运行时间: Remaining life is approximately (allowable wear divided by wear rate divided by daily operating time) minus operating time used
map.基于低磨损寿命模型：以磨损率（年磨损量）、允许磨损量与日运行时间推算剩余寿命，扣: Based on the low wear life model: from wear rate (annual wear amount), allowable wear and daily operating time estimate remaining life, subtract operating time used to get available life, for wear part replacement warning.
map.💡 磨损寿命(年) = 允许磨损量 / (磨损率 × 日运行时间/24)；检测周: Wear life (years) = allowable wear / (wear rate times daily operating time / 24); inspection interval = life / 3
map.磨损率以 24h/天 为基准，需按实际运行时间折算: Wear rate is based on 24 h/day; it must be converted by actual operating time
map.不同磨损类型加速因子不同：磨粒 1.0，粘着 0.8，疲劳 1.2，腐蚀 1.5: Different wear types have different acceleration factors: abrasive 1.0, adhesive 0.8, fatigue 1.2, corrosive 1.5
map.建议检测周期取剩余寿命的 1/3，保证安全裕度: Recommended inspection interval takes one third of remaining life for safety margin
map.📚 深度解析：低磨损寿命（磨损类型因子修正）: In-depth: Low Wear Life (wear type factor correction)
map.耐磨件定寿：按: Wear part life determination: compute total life and remaining life by
map.在役评估：输入已运行小时算已磨损量与磨损: In-service assessment: input operating hours used to compute worn amount and wear
map.工况对比：改变日运行时间或磨损类型后的寿命变化: Condition comparison: life change after changing daily operating time or wear type
map.算法：运行率 = 日运行小时/24；修正磨损率 = 输入磨损率×运行率×磨损类型: Algorithm: operating rate = daily operating hours / 24; corrected wear rate = input wear rate times operating rate times wear type factor (abrasive 1.0, adhesive 0.8, fatigue 1.2, corrosive 1.5); total wear life = allowable wear / corrected wear rate (years); worn amount = corrected wear rate times (operating hours used / 8760); remaining life = total life minus operating hours used / 8760; inspection interval = remaining life / 3; wear percentage = worn amount / allowable wear times 100%.
map.例：磨粒磨损、0.05mm/年、允许磨损 1.5mm、日运行 16h、未使用 →: Example: abrasive wear, 0.05 mm/year, allowable wear 1.5 mm, daily 16 h, unused gives operating rate 0.6667, corrected wear rate 0.03333 mm/year, total life 45 years, remaining 45 years, inspection interval 15 years, slight wear, normal use. Change to corrosive wear (factor 1.5), daily 24 h, 20000 h used gives corrected wear rate 0.075 mm/year, total life 20 years, worn 0.17 mm (11.4%), remaining 17.7 years, inspection interval 5.9 years. If wear rate rises to 0.5 mm/year gives corrected 0.75 mm/year, total life only 2 years, worn 1.71 mm (114.2%), remaining life negative, exceeded wear limit, replace immediately.
map.输入磨损率是什么口径？: What is the input wear rate caliber?
map.指连续满负荷运行下的年磨损深度（mm/年）。若手上的数据是 mm/1000h，需: It refers to the annual wear depth under continuous full-load operation (mm/year). If your data is mm / 1000 h, convert: mm/year = mm / 1000 h times 8.76. The tool then converts by daily operating hours to the actual operating rate.
map.类型因子为什么腐蚀磨损最高？: Why is corrosive wear the highest type factor?
map.腐蚀与磨损耦合会互相加速：腐蚀产物被磨掉后露出新鲜表面继续腐蚀，总损失大于单独作: Corrosion and wear coupling accelerates each other: after the corrosion product is worn away, fresh surface continues to corrode, total loss is greater than the sum of the two alone, so take 1.5; fatigue wear also takes 1.2 due to crack propagation; adhesive wear under good lubrication is lower than abrasive wear, take 0.8.
